content.title: Telkom Indonesia to spin off wholesale fibre connectivity business in $2.16 billion deal
content.summary: Telkom Indonesia agreed on Tuesday to partially spin off its wholesale fibre connectivity business to its subsidiary Telkom Infrastruktur Indonesia in a deal valued at 35.787 trillion rupiah ($2.16 billion). The transaction is a material and affiliated party transaction under domestic rules and will have no significant impact on the financial conditions of the company, Telkom Indonesia said in a statement. The spin-off will help improve business focus and optimize the utilization of fibre optic network assets.
